evidence.note: The Nobel scientific background (available 2024-10-08) says Rumelhart, Hinton and Williams reinvented a scheme that others had used earlier. This supports the claim that Hinton has no original priority.

A 2020 report quotes Hinton rejecting credit for inventing backprop and saying others invented it earlier. The article also dates the basics to the 1960s. This is a secondhand quotation but corroborates e1.
The Nobel press release foregrounds the Boltzmann machine. It bears on the unscored citation impression, not on who invented backprop.

reviews.rationale: The Nobel committee's own scientific background describes the 1986 work as a reinvention of a scheme others had used earlier. Hinton's reported 2020 statement also disclaims invention. Both meet the support condition: Hinton was not the original inventor. Nothing in the packet shows Hinton had original priority.
